title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a 'formulaire', a reference table of matrix formulas fixing generators and conventions in GL(2,Z). It serves the 'transcendental viewpoint for M_{1,1}' announced on p.28. The setting is the Legendre picture. P^1_λ minus {0,1,∞} is uniformized by the congruence subgroup Γ(2), and the cusps of Γ(2) are matched with the punctures as i∞→0, 0→1, 1→∞.

(1) ρ = [[0,1],[-1,1]] has order 6, with ρ^3 = ω = -I. Conjugation by ρ permutes the three cusps cyclically (0→1→∞→0). It realises the cyclic Z/3 symmetry of P^1 minus {0,1,∞}, lifted to SL2(Z).

(2) σ_∞ = [[0,1],[-1,0]] (the standard S) has σ^2 = ω. Its ρ-conjugates are σ_0 = [[-1,1],[-2,1]] and σ_1 = [[-1,2],[-1,1]]. They are lifts of the three transpositions of S_3 = SL2(Z)/±Γ(2).

(3) ε_0 = [[1,-1],[0,1]], ε_1 = [[1,0],[1,1]] and ε_∞ = [[2,-1],[1,0]] are regular unipotents, with nilpotent logs N_i = ε_i - 1. They fix the cusps ∞, 0 and 1 respectively, i.e. the 'square roots' of the inertia generators.

(4) ρ_i = ε_i^2 are the parabolic generators of Γ(2): [[1,-2],[0,1]], [[1,0],[2,1]], [[3,-2],[2,-1]]. They satisfy ρ_∞ρ_1ρ_0 = ω. With ρ'_i = ωρ_i one gets ρ'_∞ρ'_1ρ'_0 = 1. This is the image of the standard presentation of π_1(P^1 minus {0,1,∞}) = π_{0,3} = ⟨x_0,x_1,x_∞ | x_∞x_1x_0 = 1⟩ in SL2(Z).

(5) Mixed relations, all checked:
- σ_iσ_{i+1} = ωρρ_i = ωρ_{i+1}ρ;
- σ_{i+1} = ωρ_{i-1}ε_{i+1};
- σ_iρσ_i^{-1} = ρ^{-1}ρ'_{i-1}.

(6) The determinant -1 involutions are τ_∞ = diag(-1,1), τ_0 and τ_1. They are lifts of complex conjugation (z ↦ -z̄ on H), i.e. of the real structure of P^1 minus {0,1,∞}. They satisfy τ_iτ_{i-1} = ρ'_{i+1}.

(7) A second family τ'_i = σ_iτ_i are also involutions, with τ'_∞ = [[0,1],[1,0]]. They satisfy τ'_iτ'_{i+1} = ωρ and τ'_{i+1}τ'_i = ωρ^{-1}. Together with the dictionary between σ, τ and τ', this sets up the next page. There Grothendieck builds the surjection from π_{0,3}^τ (π_{0,3} extended by complex conjugation) onto GL(2,Z), lying over π_{0,3} → SL(2,Z). He also writes the amalgam/reflection presentation GL(2,Z) = D_6 *_{D_2} D_4.

The purpose is to fix sign and index conventions so that π_{0,3}, its S_3 symmetries and complex conjugation are all expressed compatibly inside GL2(Z). This is groundwork for comparing Gal(Q̄/Q) / Teichmüller-tower actions on π_{0,3} and on π_{1,1}.
errors: The formula 'ε_i = σ_i^{-1}ρ' is off by one index. Direct computation gives σ_∞^{-1}ρ = ε_0, σ_0^{-1}ρ = ε_1 and σ_1^{-1}ρ = ε_∞, so the correct statement is ε_{i+1} = σ_i^{-1}ρ. The boxed definitions ε_0 = σ_∞^{-1}ρ and ε_1 = ρσ_∞^{-1} = σ_0^{-1}ρ are consistent with the corrected version. The crossed-out line next to it may be Grothendieck noticing the shift.

All other matrix identities on the page check out. These include ρ^3 = -I, σ_i^2 = -I, ρσ_iρ^{-1} = σ_{i+1}, ρ_∞ρ_1ρ_0 = -I, σ_iσ_{i+1} = ωρρ_i, σ_{i+1} = ωρ_{i-1}ε_{i+1}, σ_iρσ_i^{-1} = ρ^{-1}ρ'_{i-1}, τ_iτ_{i-1} = ρ'_{i+1}, τ'_iτ'_{i+1} = ωρ, and σ_i = τ'_iτ_i. The earlier 'ω' in the τ_iτ_{i-1} relations was rightly crossed out and replaced by ρ'.

ideas.what: Embedding of π_1(P^1 minus {0,1,∞}) into SL2(Z) via Γ(2), with inertia generators ρ_i = ε_i^2 and ρ_∞ρ_1ρ_0 = -1
ideas.modern_name: Legendre uniformization; Γ(2)/±1 ≅ F_2 as orbifold π_1 of M_{0,4}; the map π_{0,3} → Γ(2) ⊂ SL2(Z)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Legendre/Jacobi λ-function, Fricke–Klein); modern use in GT theory by Ihara, Nakamura, Lochak–Schneps
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses M_{1,1}, M_{0,4} and the Teichmüller tower qualitatively, without such a formulary

ideas.what: Lifts ρ, σ_i of the S_3 symmetry group of {0,1,∞} to SL2(Z), with the order-3 element ρ and order-4 elements σ_i
ideas.modern_name: SL2(Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6 acting on Γ(2) with quotient S_3 = SL2(F_2); the source of the 2-cycle and 3-cycle (hexagon) relations of GT
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical; in the GT context Drinfeld (1990), Ihara, Lochak–Schneps

ideas.what: Determinant -1 involutions τ_i, τ'_i lifting complex conjugation (the real structure of P^1 minus {0,1,∞}), giving π_{0,3}^τ → GL2(Z)
ideas.modern_name: Extension of π_1 by Gal(C/R); PGL2(Z) as the extended (2,3,∞) triangle reflection group; GL2(Z) = D_6 *_{D_2} D_4
ideas.usually_credited_to: The amalgam is classical (Serre, Trees); the role of complex conjugation in GT is due to Drinfeld/Ihara (the element of GT corresponding to complex conjugation)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful, correct (apart from one index slip) table of conventions for standard elements of GL2(Z) adapted to π_{0,3}, S_3 symmetries and complex conjugation. It documents Grothendieck's setup for the M_{0,4}/M_{1,1} level of the Teichmüller tower, but all its content is classical. The anticipation of the GT relations is implicit only; the relations themselves appear on neighbouring pages and in Drinfeld/Ihara.
transcription_corrections: The relation written as 'ε_i = σ_i^{-1}ρ' is in the image, but it holds only with the index shift ε_{i+1} = σ_i^{-1}ρ; the crossed-out line above it is illegible (possibly 'ρ(ε_i) = ε_{i+1}' or a corrected index).
The third σ matrix is labelled σ_1 (smudged in the image), with σ_1 = [[-1,2],[-1,1]].
In the brace 'τ_1τ_0 = ρ'_∞, τ_∞τ_1 = ρ'_0, τ_0τ_∞ = ρ'_1', an initial ω was struck out and replaced by the primed ρ'; the primes are present in the image.
The bottom line, partly cut off, reads σ_i = τ'_iτ_i = ωτ_iτ'_i.
